notes.title: County Courier is now playable in Ukrainian and Russian
notes.content: Releasing County Courier update with translations for Ukrainian and Russian languages!

notes.title: Update April 16th
notes.content:
Thank you all for purchasing County Courier, we hope you are enjoying your adventures of delivering packages all across the county while also upgrading your truck at the same time. Below are bug fixes and a few new features that will hopefully make the game more enjoyable! Coming soon we will release a walkthrough video of the game and an updated trailer.

[u]Updates:[/u]
[list]
[*] Added a map
[*] Added 5 new drop off locations
[*] Added languages Spanish, French (See "Settings" in Menu to change language)
[*] Added a refresh button to Deliveries List to help with language changing
[*] Updated icons to indicate pickup location vs dropoff location
[*] Fixed UI to scale better
[*] Updated Store UI
[*] Updated Personalization/Customization UI
[*] If you have read this far, drive to the fountain/pond in the park to receive token of our appreciation :)
[/list]

If you encounter any issues in this upgrade please inform us on the Speedtrap Studios Blog or email us directly and we'll try and support you as best we can.
